Thanks Naomi and Lindsey. I’m Marissa (Head of CS Ops) — happy to own security/procurement touchpoints. A few operational clarifications from our side before the co-edit session:

- Pilot scope: please confirm expected data types and typical sequence length for LLM calls (Holloway usually runs protected health text + metadata). If you can paste a sanitized sample or rows we’ll use that to size required throttling/throughput.
- Acceptance criteria: propose we split criteria into Technical (latency, error rate, model-output fidelity vs. sample evals) and Business (workflow completion rate, clinician satisfaction survey > 80%). I added a table in the doc under "Acceptance Metrics" — please review.
- SOW: Naomi, drop the 1-pager in the doc. Procurement at Holloway usually needs a 14-day review window.

I can join tomorrow’s co-edit but if we need engineering review we should invite Rishi (rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai) to the doc thread.

Hi all — Ben here (Solutions Architect). I pulled a short tech checklist into the doc under "Engineering asks":

- Network: will Holloway allow outbound HTTPS to our regional endpoints? If not, we can discuss a VPC or private deployment option during the evaluation.
- Data retention: can Holloway confirm retention window expectations (30/90/365 days)? We can provide configurable retention with an on/off ingestion flag in the pilot.
- Throughput: estimate expected concurrent requests/day and average tokens per request. If you want, I can run a quick cost estimate once we have those numbers.

I think the plan looks good. Lindsey — if 10am PT tomorrow still works, I’ll bring a short slide that maps the technical milestones to the swimlane.
